title: termal_submit_acceptance_evaluation returns 500 'not acknowledged as persisted … (Deadline: queued for the writer)' when the persistence writer is slow
outcome: An evaluator's submission does not fail with a 500 merely because TermAl's persistence writer missed its acknowledgement deadline. Either the host waits for, or reconciles, the queued write, or it returns a typed, retry-safe outcome that tells the evaluator whether the submission was sent, so that an identical retry is known to be safe.
acceptance: termal_submit_acceptance_evaluation returns 500 'not acknowledged as persisted … (Deadline: queued for the writer)' when the persistence writer is slow is done
